lines: Somewhere a bell is ringing
Words that aren't like me come to mind
The cold feels kind of nice, mh
Wait, why am I in love like this?
It's probably the songs going on about holy night,
and the streets glittering so deliberately
How often I want to see you,
how this chest aches when I can't—
they're trying to tell me how I feel about you
It's fine, I already know that myself
No use asking Santa or whoever, huh
If I could have it, I'd want you by my side
I'd want you going nowhere
I'd want you thinking only of me, always
But saying all that would look uncool,
and it'd just drag on, so let me sum it up
I love you
These giddy couples,
wearing reindeer antlers and all,
how can they do that in public?
No, it's not that I'm jealous or anything
What present would make you happy?
What's the thing only I could give you?
Even if your answer when I said I love you wasn't what I hoped
there's no way that alone could make me stop loving you
Wishing on a star isn't really my style, but
in the end, if it's not you, I don't want it
that's why I'm looking up
Meeting you back then—that alone was enough
for sides of myself I never knew to surface, one after another
Every day I want to see you
and I want you to know it
In the passing crowds, I'm searching for you
On a day like this, are you laughing with someone else?
Deep, deep in my chest, it starts to hurt
If I could have it, I'd want you by my side
I'd want you going nowhere
I'd want you thinking only of me, always
But saying this really would look uncool,
and it'd just drag on, so let me sum it up
I love you
I'll say it as many times as it takes for you to hear
I love you
